paragraphs: This repository holds KUKO WAY, a standalone, independently-deployable platform for body awareness and daily practice — guided Fascial Maneuvers, breathing and reset practices, educational content and personal progress — in Bulgarian (default) and English. It is designed as a calm practice space, not a fitness or medical app. The Next.js application lives in platform/ — see platform/README.md for setup instructions. This top-level README summarizes what the product is, what is built, and what is not yet.
Production (test phase): — see Deployment and CI for what is live and what is still limited (payments run in Stripe test mode only).

This project has no connection to, dependency on, or shared infrastructure with app.humangarage.net — that product was used only as a functional/structural reference during planning, never as code, content, or a live integration.
